purpose: Unapproved held-out confirmation of the mechanism-selected MambaTSv3 relation-auxiliary-only candidate against seven same-source baselines on Electricity and Traffic H96.
research_question: Does retaining AutoCon relation training while disabling prediction-connected representation fusion remain non-inferior to strong forecasting and Mamba baselines on untouched Electricity/Traffic H96 test windows?
evidence_boundary: Unapproved draft. No job may be launched and no held-out metric may be read until a human approval sidecar binds this exact plan SHA-256.
claim_boundary: If approved and passed, this release supports only Electricity/Traffic H96 comparisons. It cannot establish universal accuracy, causal AutoCon attribution, or universal speed superiority.

required_before_launch: verify Electricity and Traffic fingerprints and exact 86-job expansion
confirm the relation-auxiliary-only candidate and seven comparator configurations are frozen from validation
approve the exact plan SHA-256 in a separate launch sidecar
run all phases from one immutable source snapshot and read test metrics only after strict validation

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Candidate, baselines, data split, optimizer, scheduler, budget, normalization, horizon, and confirmation seeds are frozen before test execution; no held-out signal may select a model or setting.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share chronological split, M features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, epochs, patience, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: Only MambaTSv3AutoCon receives the frozen AutoCon objective with lambda=.001; prediction-connected representation fusion remains disabled.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: DLinear, NLinear, RLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, iTransformer, and Mamba2 receive no AutoCon, representation-fusion, ACF-memory, or candidate-only settings.
capacity_fairness_contract.test_read_gate: Read test metrics only after every registered phase validator succeeds.

phases.name: selection_relation_auxiliary_only_validation
phases.purpose: Validation reproducibility check for the frozen relation-auxiliary-only candidate; test split remains disabled.

phases.name: confirmatory_relation_auxiliary_only_candidate_test
phases.purpose: Frozen relation-auxiliary-only MambaTSv3 candidate held-out Electricity/Traffic H96 phase.

phases.name: confirmatory_strong_baselines_test
phases.purpose: Frozen same-source DLinear, NLinear, RLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, iTransformer, and Mamba2 held-out comparators.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report paired seed-level mean MSE, wins, one-sided upper ratio, and all failure cells; forecast windows and channels are not independent replicates.

statistical_gate.interpretation: A cell is non-inferior only if its one-sided paired upper MSE ratio is <=1.02. Five confirmation seeds are the uncertainty unit.

resource_contract.efficiency_claim_gate: Report prediction-only speed only for named comparators whose registered accuracy gate passes; never use training wall time as inference throughput.

confirm relation-auxiliary-only candidate and seven comparator configurations are frozen from validation
approve the exact plan SHA-256 in a separate launch sidecar
execute all phases from one immutable source snapshot and read test metrics only after strict validation
